note: GFP state park on a wooded bend of the James River, 7 mi E of Redfield off US-212, at the historic Belchers Ford stage crossing. One loop of electric sites (three pull-throughs) under the trees; the park is run by the adjoining Fisher Grove Country Club, whose ten-hole golf course is next door. Canoe and kayak access to the river; warming shelter. --Claude
